_doc: Vectors of blade_fuses. Rated currents are in A; text cells are the English text. The colours come from the maker catalogues named in each ref (ISO 8820-3 itself was not read).

cells.ref: 10 A is red in the standard code: all five makers' documents (Littelfuse 2005 catalogue and aftermarket page, Bussmann 2018, OptiFuse, HELLA, MTA)
Littelfuse ATO 257 colour code = Bussmann ATC-10/ATM-10 = OptiFuse APR = HELLA = MTA uniVAL; Littelfuse 2025 datasheet swatch red
7.5 A brown in the standard code: all five makers; Littelfuse MINI/ATOF 2024/2025 swatch brown
30 A green in the standard code: all five makers
Littelfuse 2005, Bussmann ATC-35 and OptiFuse APR/APM name it blue-green; HELLA says dark green; Littelfuse ATOF 2025 swatch is a darker blue-green
35 A as Mini: OptiFuse APM-35A and HELLA; regular: Littelfuse ATOF, Bussmann, OptiFuse, HELLA (not at MTA)

cells.want: micro2, micro3, LP mini, mini, regular
cells.ref: Micro2: Littelfuse 327 + Bussmann ATR-5 + OptiFuse APT; Micro3: Littelfuse 337 + OptiFuse ANK; LP mini: Bussmann ATM-LP, OptiFuse APS, HELLA
40 A orange in the standard code: Littelfuse, Bussmann ATC-40, OptiFuse APR, HELLA, MTA
40 A only as regular blade fuse: Littelfuse ATOF 0287040, Bussmann, OptiFuse APR, HELLA
35 A MAXI brown: Littelfuse 2005 catalogue (299) and Bussmann MAX-35 agree; Littelfuse 299 2025 swatch brown
35 A MAXI: Littelfuse 299 series ratings 20 to 80 A including 35 A, Bussmann MAX-35
30 A MAXI green: all five makers
50 A MAXI red: all five makers
70 A MAXI tan: Littelfuse 299, Bussmann MAX-70, OptiFuse APX; beige at MTA maxiVAL; HELLA gives brown (the only dissent)
100 A MAXI violet: MTA maxiVAL and OptiFuse APX; Bussmann MAX-100ID only as indicating type; not at Littelfuse (299 ends at 80 A) or HELLA
MTA maxiVAL and OptiFuse APX violet; Bussmann MAX-100ID purple

cells.want: Bussmann also lists a 1 A Mini (ATM-1); only one maker, so not listed as Mini
cells.ref: Bussmann catalogue 1007 (2018) ATM-1; no second maker lists a 1 A Mini
